The test image shows soybean seeds held in a hand. Several seeds show purple/violet discoloration — some with large blotches covering much of the seed surface, others with smaller spots. The base seed color is tan/yellow. This is clearly a seed-level symptom with purple staining.

Top candidates: **Purple_Seed_Stain** (pink to purple seed discoloration) and **Cercospora** (pink to purple seed coat discoloration). Let me check reference images for both, plus a few other seed-affecting classes.
Good match — seeds with purple/violet discoloration on tan background. Now check Cercospora seed reference.
Cercospora shows purple/brown blotches extending from the hilum — very similar to the test image. Now check another Purple_Seed_Stain reference and Phomopsis seeds.

This is an almost identical match to the test image — same hand, same seed appearance, same purple blotching pattern, same ring visible. Very strong confirmation for Purple_Seed_Stain. I still need to view 4 more reference images from different classes to meet the budget requirement.
Phomopsis shows shriveled, moldy, chalky-white seeds — very different from the test image. Now checking Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus seed and Pythium seed.
Bean_Pod_Mottle shows black mottled seeds in a pod — different from the purple blotching in the test image. Two more references needed.
Pythium shows seedling damping-off — completely different from the test image. One more reference needed.

This Purple_Seed_Stain pod reference shows the characteristic purple blotch on a seed within the pod — same purple coloration pattern as the test image.

**Summary of evidence:**
- Test image: seeds held in a hand with a ring visible, tan/yellow base color, multiple seeds with pink-to-purple blotches of varying sizes
- `Purple_Seed_Stain/seed/Soybean_Dise_18.jpg` is nearly identical to the test image (same hand, same ring, same seed pattern, same background)
- Purple_Seed_Stain description: "pink to purple spots ranging from specks to large blotches covering the entire surface" — exact match
- Cercospora seeds showed similar purple hilum staining but more concentrated at hilum; the test image shows larger irregular blotches, more consistent with Purple_Seed_Stain
- All other seed classes (Phomopsis, Bean_Pod_Mottle, Pythium) look clearly different
